reproductionScope: Recompiled the project extractor and relinked the same prebuilt LLVM archive. This is not a source rebuild of LLVM libraries.
prefixMapReason: Required to reproduce __FILE__ strings embedded by header assertions; without remapping, absolute include paths change data layout.
mapStage: wasm-ld output before Emscripten/Binaryen final optimization; optimization can remove additional code. Not every selected object is asserted to survive in the final binary.

providerPatch.effect: Adds an __EMSCRIPTEN__ branch returning a fixed /usr/lib/libclang.wasm executable path. Three added lines and one replaced conditional; not a Clang CMake patch.

remaining: The provider repository at the pinned commit has no root license or separate permission statement for its patch. This does not negate the LLVM upstream license. Clarify the modification grant or remove dependency on the provider modification using an independently controlled source build.
